subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should maintainers land the open MS Teams migration-guard PR as the fix for this issue, or require broader recovery or packaged-upgrade proof first?
rationale: The issue has a focused candidate fix, but persisted-state migration archive behavior affects upgrades and recovery expectations for existing users.

options.title: Review And Land The Guard
options.body: Accept the narrow visibility guard as the immediate fix for preventing non-empty legacy conversation sources from being archived when no retained rows are visible.

options.title: Require Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted packaged upgrade or doctor transcript before merge if exact release-to-patched behavior must be proven first.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery
options.body: Hold the candidate PR if the same branch must also recover already archived sources or handle partial migrations.

recommendation.title: Review And Land The Guard
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow visibility guard as the immediate fix for preventing non-empty legacy conversation sources from being archived when no retained rows are visible.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the clearest current-main history on the affected migration files and adjacent state-migration surface.
